scope: Proposition 6.7 (Returns and finite capture) of the manuscript “The critical Liouville quantum sphere and geometric limits of FK maps at q=4” (preprints/The-critical-Liouville-quantum-sphere-and-geometric-limits-of-FK-maps-at-q-equals-4-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 211 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 9b9236021eab20eb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 96. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For each return C′ born in a paired sweep of C, C′ ⊂ C. (6.1) Every return is captured as one untouched negative pocket by finitely many ordinary full-fan branches from ∂C, and has empty inherited open target interval. Conversely a complete negative birth with empty inherited target interval is a stabilized return. As the finite target lists increase densely, the two-layer walls stabilize exactly on interior compact sets and the uncaptured negative pockets have uniformly vanishing closure diameters.
